Welcome

Echolocate uses WiFi signal patterns to monitor crowding in shared spaces — without cameras, faces, or names. Pick the mode that fits you:

You can switch any time using the tabs at the bottom.

What IS collected

  • Aggregate occupancy levels (calm / busy / crowded)
  • Anonymous rotating tokens (15-min rotation, opt-in only)
  • Zone+time pairs you visited (only after you check in)
  • Spatial metadata from snapshot-triggered AI analysis
  • Anonymous community feedback you submit

What is NEVER collected

  • Photos, video, or audio
  • Faces or biometric features
  • Names, email addresses, phone numbers
  • Device fingerprints, IP addresses, MAC addresses
  • Any history outside this space

Verifiable by code review: the SQLite schema literally has no column for any of the above. See backend/storage.py.

Notify visitors

Send an anonymous broadcast to everyone who visited a zone within a time window. You don't see who they are — the message is delivered to their inboxes and to push if they've enabled it. Use cases: exposure alert, ventilation issue, scheduled closure, follow-up survey.
